proposal.reason: Primary change is a new host one-sided RMA API surface (pcclPutSignal/pcclSignal/pcclWaitSignal, new config/ABI fields) that is not explicitly owned by an existing catalog scope, so `other` is required. `enqueue` is needed for new RMA task types, planner queues, batching, and launch-path integration. `gin` is needed for the new cross-node RMA proxy transport path, GIN proxy wrappers, plugin loading/contexts, and progress thread logic. `copy-engine` is needed for the in-node CE RMA execution path (signal windows, CE put/wait launch, stream/event sync). `communicator` is needed for new communicator configuration/validation (`numRmaCtx`), capability negotiation/reporting, lifecycle init/finalize wiring, and async error surfacing. `profiler` is needed for new RMA API event types and profiler schema/integration updates.
